display_long_description:
**Which is more flexible – your mind 🧠 or your wrist 🖐️?**

Awesome Hand is a hand-tracking VR puzzle where your hands are the controllers.
No controllers needed — your real hands become the game’s input device.

# 🏆Official Award Recognition🏆
This game received the  **Best Implementation of Hand Interactions** special award in the **2025 Meta Horizon Start Developer Competition**, Meta’s official developer competition.
[media]

# Hand-Tracking Puzzle Gameplay👍
Use your palms and fingers to curve the ball’s path, interact with playful hand-based gimmicks, and guide it all the way to the goal.

The rules are simple, but mastering how your movements influence the ball creates an addicting blend of physical skill and spatial problem-solving.

Whether you want a light, relaxing experience or a clever challenge, Awesome Hand lets you play at your own pace.

# 135 Handcrafted Stages👋
It features 135 handcrafted stages to test your creativity and control!!
